name: @playform/hook-dsh-core
description: The CORE: the pure, harness-free commonalities of the governance family (@playform/hook-dsh-core) — the dependency-section list, the exclusion-segment list, the suppression-line composer, the update-policy loader and the refusal guard — shipped in BOTH builds under ONE name: the CLASSIC (dependency-free, the default) and the EFFECT-TS (effect-backed, toggled at the loader level via the effect-ts condition). A NEW governance module reduces to a Config extension, a pure transform and an update engine; the core owns the shared pure mechanics and the module's ledger strings stay module-side. Usable outside the harness entirely (the PlayForm ecosystem).
